evidence.observation: H701 reads 446.2 °C while H702 reads 71.8 °C and the reboiler reads 74.1 °C, a pronounced temperature discrepancy.
The discrepancy persists: H701 is 449.4 °C, H702 is 70.4 °C, and the reboiler is 77.4 °C. Actual localized overheating versus a temperature-measurement fault is unresolved.
Distillate and reflux flows both read zero; column temperatures are 74.7, 64.3, 63.5 and 63.4 °C respectively. These readings do not establish separation performance.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature verification, heater power/setpoint and permitted temperature limits are needed to distinguish overheating from a sensor fault. Pressure instruments are not installed, so pressure-related causes cannot be assessed directly. No composition measurement or separation target is provided.
